# SmallPDF.us — Free Online PDF & Document Tools

> SmallPDF.us is a free, privacy-first online platform offering professional-grade PDF and document conversion tools. No account required, no file size paywall, files auto-deleted after 2 hours.

## Tools Available

### PDF Conversion
- PDF to Word (DOCX) — Convert PDF documents to editable Word format
- Word to PDF — Convert DOC/DOCX files to PDF
- PDF to Excel (XLSX) — Extract tables from PDFs into spreadsheets
- Excel to PDF — Convert XLS/XLSX spreadsheets to PDF
- PDF to PowerPoint (PPTX) — Convert PDFs into editable presentations
- PowerPoint to PDF — Convert PPT/PPTX presentations to PDF

### PDF Management
- Merge PDF — Combine multiple PDF files into one document
- Split PDF — Extract specific pages or split PDF into multiple files
- Compress PDF — Reduce PDF file size while maintaining quality
- Rotate PDF — Rotate pages in a PDF document
- Unlock PDF — Remove password protection from PDF files
- Protect PDF — Add password protection to PDF files
- OCR PDF — Extract text from scanned/image-based PDFs

### Image Conversion
- JPG to PDF — Convert JPEG images to PDF format
- PNG to PDF — Convert PNG images to PDF format
- PDF to JPG — Extract pages from PDF as JPEG images
- PDF to PNG — Extract pages from PDF as PNG images
- PNG to WebP — Convert PNG images to WebP format
- WebP to PNG — Convert WebP images to PNG format
- Compress Image — Optimize JPG, PNG, WebP images for web/email

## Key Features
- 100% free, no registration required
- 256-bit SSL encryption for all file transfers
- Files automatically deleted from servers after 2 hours
- GDPR compliant — no data collection or sharing
- Supports 8 languages: English, Japanese, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Indonesian, Portuguese
- Works on all devices: desktop, tablet, mobile
- No file size limits for most operations

## Technical Details
- Built with Next.js (frontend) and Node.js/Express (backend)
- LibreOffice-powered document conversion
- Python/pdfplumber for PDF table extraction
- Sharp for image processing

## URL Structure
- Homepage: https://smallpdf.us
- Tools: https://smallpdf.us/{tool-name}/ (e.g. /merge-pdf/, /compress-pdf/)
- Localized: https://smallpdf.us/{locale}/{tool-name}/ (e.g. /fr/compresser-pdf/)
